author: (Steindachner, 1864)
evidence: OBIS: one 1968 record from Cahuita Bay old pier at 1.5 m
Listed as "corvinilla ojo chica" in the 2010 Rev. Biol. Trop. field guide
Ophioscion costaricensis Caldwell 1958 from Tortuguero is a synonym

about.en: The smalleye stardrum is a small croaker of sand and mud with a low mouth and a rhomboid tail. It was recorded at the old Cahuita pier at 1.5 m in 1968. The fish once named Ophioscion costaricensis, described from Tortuguero, is a synonym of this species. It is too small to matter to anglers.
about.es: La corvinilla ojo chica es un roncador pequeño de arena y fango con boca baja y cola romboidal. Se registró en el viejo muelle de Cahuita a 1.5 m en 1968. El pez que se llamó Ophioscion costaricensis, descrito en Tortuguero, es sinónimo de esta especie. Es demasiado pequeña para interesar a los pescadores.

idTips.en: Small silvery croaker with an inferior mouth, a rhomboid tail and a small eye.
idTips.es: Roncador plateado pequeño con boca inferior, cola romboidal y ojo pequeño.

behaviour.en: Lives on sand and mud close to the bottom, often in shallow water near piers.
behaviour.es: Vive sobre arena y fango pegada al fondo, a menudo en aguas someras cerca de muelles.

where.en: Shallow sand near Cahuita; spots not documented.
where.es: Arena somera cerca de Cahuita; sitios no documentados.

edibleNote.en: Too small to be a food fish.
edibleNote.es: Demasiado pequeña para ser un pez de mesa.

sources.t: Rev. Biol. Trop. 58 (Suppl. 2) 2010, field guide to the marine fishes of Caribbean Costa Rica, Sciaenidae page
